subject.title: feat(repair): add digest-bound Gitcrawl evidence intake

question: After the cursor-lock race is fixed, should this release require versioned Gitcrawl evidence and quarantine legacy imported jobs?
rationale: The feature intentionally changes persisted-job compatibility and makes cloud or parity availability part of repair intake, so cutover timing and operational ownership require maintainer intent.

options.title: Fix and approve guarded cutover
options.body: Repair lock ownership, restore the full required check, and land with an operator-approved migration, rollback, and provider-incident plan.

options.title: Fix and stage enforcement
options.body: Land evidence acquisition and verification while deferring mandatory legacy quarantine to a separately approved rollout.

options.title: Pause the subsystem
options.body: Do not land if reliable lock ownership or provider and migration operations cannot be supported.

recommendation.title: Fix and approve guarded cutover
recommendation.body: Repair lock ownership, restore the full required check, and land with an operator-approved migration, rollback, and provider-incident plan.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main provenance and the proposed implementation make this person the strongest available owner for the rollout decision.
